On Wed, Jun 30, 2027 at 9:58 AM hannah_schmitt@redwood.com wrote:
> Two asks from my side:
> 1) Can Markus and Jonas add 3–4 anchor criteria (short bullets) ahead of the interviews for consistent leveling?

Adding anchors here. I'll attach a short doc (interview_rubric_anchor_v1.docx) to formalize, but quick bullets below for the architecture/production slot: 

- Scope mastery: can articulate where to apply caching, sharding, and how model/kernel choices affect throughput.
- Latency reasoning: explains end-to-end tail latency sources and mitigation trade-offs (e.g., batching vs. immediate return).
- Reliability & SLOs: defines sensible SLOs for different routes and a plan for graceful degradation (fallback models, reduced precision).
- Ownership signals: past examples where candidate owned incidents or performance regression rollouts.

Marissa — for implementation: I prefer a small, focused take-home (30–60 minute exercise) we can ask candidate to do live or unsupervised and then discuss. Keeps the slot on-time and gives us reproducible material. I can draft a 30-minute prompt and attach it if you want.

-Markus
Markus Klein

Thanks Markus — this is great. I attached a short question packet (interview_question_packet_v3.pdf) and a 30-minute implementation prompt that maps to the anchors Markus proposed. Key additions for my slot:

- Specific gating question on quantization: ask candidate to compare INT8 vs FP16 trade-offs for a 7B transformer in production (latency, accuracy, memory).
- Clarity on observable signals we expect them to propose during a post-rollout incident.
- Scoring: pass / marginal / fail with clear examples that map to anchor bullets.

I'll convert the prompt into a one-page take-home we can email Priya if Hannah wants to offer that as the format.
